limits: Setup and lifetime checks, not lighting-quality or timing measurements.
One Windows/NVIDIA device; native fits use 64 rays/probe and six or eight submitted frames, sampled at checkpoints.
One volume can be too coarse for large sites; manual local volumes remain supported.
Exact CPU payload excludes Vulkan/VMA alignment and per-frame owner allocations.
Earlier transport/quality snapshots remain immutable and retain their original executable/source identities.
